verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a GPU's companion software (AMD Software, which shows performance reports and HYPR-RX profiles) could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or tuning suggestions. However, nothing in the evidence shows any in-product AI that analyzes the user's data and suggests actions. The ROCm, vLLM and llama.cpp support only lets users run their own AI workloads on the card, which is not a built-in insights feature.
